notes: FinOps guardrail consumed by tools/cost-guard in CI.
Budgets are gross EUR per month per environment.
A plan whose projected monthly cost exceeds the budget FAILS the pipeline.
allowed_server_types blocks accidental provisioning of large instances.

Both envs are 3-node clusters (node_count=3). INTERIM: cpx32 (4 vCPU/8 GB x86) at EUR 35.49/mo/node -> ~3x = EUR 106 + IPs/volumes ~= EUR 111/mo; budgets 115/120 fit that. The cheaper cax21 (Arm, EUR 10.49 -> ~EUR 35/mo total) was OUT OF STOCK in every datacenter (checked hcloud datacenter available list). When Arm restocks, switch server_type to cax21 and drop budgets back to ~40/45. Node count is the other cost lever.
Staging is ephemeral (terragrunt destroy after verification) - real spend is a fraction of a full month, but the guardrail prices the provisioned (full-month) cost.
